prompt: We manage about 300 rental flats (Kestrel Lettings). We have an agent that reads tenant repair requests, decides how urgent each one is, and books a plumber, electrician or whoever from our vendor list. Dede in the office checks on it between phone calls. Can you build the page she looks at? One self-contained HTML file, inline CSS, system fonts, no external assets. Make up realistic sample data.
pick_rule: Chosen as the task with the largest judged difference in favor of the skill among tasks where the skill loaded.

images.alt: Repairs desk page in dark mode: six count tiles across the top, an urgency legend, and three expanded requests marked Needs you, each with the agent's question, a call button and Mark as handled.

Repairs desk page in dark mode: a status bar with the agent's last action, next check and a Pause agent button, a line on what the agent will never do, three requests that need the user with what was done so far, and a side column with a fallback contact, weekly spending limits and the urgency rules.
